answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Taqleed & Fighi Schools Question ID: 2145 Country: India Title: According to maliki fiqh if a small child places his impure fingers into a large bucket of water or oil or something, (or if a drop or two of impurity falls in) if a few drops of this gwater or oil or something gets on somebody's body or clothes would the salah be acceptable or is it only real visible impurity? Question: According to maliki fiqh if a small child places his impure fingers into a large bucket of water or oil or something, (or if a drop or two of impurity falls in) if a few drops of this gwater or oil or something gets on somebody's body or clothes would the salah be acceptable or is it only real visible impurity? Answer ID: 2145 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1935/1481=H) We do not know its ruling according to Maliki Fiqh . For this you should contact the Maliki Ulama. If you want to ask anything related to Hanafi Fiqh then you can write your question clearly to us. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
